content.text:
You are the Niyam encoder. Update this rulebook so it matches a new government document.

The validated change set is in `.niyam/changeset.json`. It lists each change with its exact source quote, page and clause.
The source document is registered in `sources/index.yaml` as `gr-202406281814018230` (date 2024-06-28).

Do this:
1. Read CLAUDE.md (the rulebook rules), the change set, and the files of the affected scheme(s): mh.ladki_bahin.
2. Apply every change in the change set, following CLAUDE.md exactly:
   - parameter change: add a new dated value under `values:` starting 2024-06-28. Never edit or delete older values.
   - condition change: set `valid_until` on the old condition to the day before 2024-06-28, and add a new condition with the same id and `valid_from: 2024-06-28`.
   - condition removed: only set `valid_until` to the day before 2024-06-28.
   - every new value or condition gets `source` / `metadata.reference` with doc `gr-202406281814018230`, page, clause, quote (copied from the change set) and quote_en.
   - if a change needs a new person field, add it to `schema/person.yaml` with a safe default that keeps existing results unchanged.
3. Add test citizens to `tests/` for every change, dated on or after 2024-06-28: just below, at, and just above each limit, plus one case dated before 2024-06-28 proving the old rule still applies. Each case cites `GR 202406281814018230 p.<page> clause <clause>` in `source`.
4. Add an entry at the top of CHANGELOG.md (English, Hindi, Marathi) linking to the document.
5. Run `python -m niyam_rulebook test` and fix problems until it prints `0 failed` with no PROBLEM lines.
6. Do not run git. Do not edit files outside schemes/, parameters/, tests/, sources/, glossary/, schema/ and CHANGELOG.md.

Finish with a short summary of what you changed and the final test result.

This document creates a new scheme. Read docs/FORMAT.md first and create every file it describes: the scheme YAML (id exactly as in the change set), one parameter file per number or list, the test file, and the source entry (already registered for you). Use only person fields from schema/person.yaml; if the document needs a fact that is missing, add a field with a default that keeps people eligible.
I'll start with the change set, the format guide, the schema, and the source index.

1	# Rulebook file format
2	
3	How to write a scheme so the engine can apply it and people can audit it. The example below is a made-up scheme; its numbers are not real.
4	
5	## 1. Register the source document: `sources/index.yaml`
6	
7	```yaml
8	gr-202501011200000000:
9	  kind: government_resolution
10	  code: "202501011200000000"
11	  date: 2025-01-01
12	  department: Example Department, Government of Maharashtra
13	  title_mr: <title in Marathi as printed>
14	  title_en: <English title>
15	  url: https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202501011200000000.pdf
16	  local: sources/mh/202501011200000000.pdf
17	  language: mr
18	```
19	
20	## 2. The scheme: `schemes/mh/<scheme_name>.yaml`
21	
22	```yaml
23	id: mh.example_support            # mh.<snake_case_name>
24	name: Example Support Yojana       # official name in English letters
25	name_mr: <name in Marathi>
26	department: Example Department, Government of Maharashtra
27	summary: One plain-English sentence on who gets what.
28	launched: 2025-01-01               # date of the founding order
29	apply_url: https://example.gov.in/  # optional
30	benefit:
31	  monthly_inr: "params.monthly_amount"      # expression; may use person and params
32	  source: {doc: gr-202501011200000000, page: 2, clause: "3", quote: "<exact words>", quote_en: "<translation>"}
33	conditions:                        # every condition must be true to be eligible
34	  - id: resident
35	    text: Lives in Maharashtra     # plain English; {param_name} is replaced by the value
36	    when: "person.state == 'MH'"   # expression over person.<field> and params.<name>
37	    valid_from: 2025-01-01
38	    source: {doc: gr-202501011200000000, page: 2, clause: "4(1)", quote: "<exact words>", quote_en: "<translation>"}
39	  - id: age
40	    text: "Aged {age_min} to {age_max}"
41	    when: "params.age_min <= person.age <= params.age_max"
42	    valid_from: 2025-01-01
43	    source: {...}
44	  - id: no_tax_payer
45	    kind: disqualification         # optional label for rules that exclude people
46	    text: No one in the family pays income tax
47	    when: "not person.family_income_tax_payer"
48	    valid_from: 2025-01-01
49	    source: {...}
50	```
51	
52	Expressions may use only `person.<field>` (fields listed in `schema/person.yaml`), `params.<name>`, comparisons (`==`, `!=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `in`, `not in`, chained like `a <= x <= b`), `and`, `or`, `not`, `+ - * /`, lists `[...]`, and `min`, `max`, `abs`, `len`.
53	
54	## 3. Parameters: `parameters/mh/<scheme_name>/<param_name>.yaml`
55	
56	One file per changeable number or list. Values are dated; never edit or delete old values, add new dates.
57	
58	```yaml
59	description: Maximum age in completed years
60	metadata:
61	  unit: year
62	values:
63	  2025-01-01:
64	    value: 60
65	    metadata:
66	      reference: {doc: gr-202501011200000000, page: 2, clause: "4(2)", quote: "<exact words>", quote_en: "<translation>"}
67	```
68	
69	## 4. Tests: `tests/mh/<scheme_name>.yaml`
70	
71	```yaml
72	scheme: mh.example_support
73	base: &base {age: 35, gender: female, state: MH, annual_family_income: 100000}
74	cases:
75	  - name: typical eligible person
76	    date: 2025-01-15
77	    person: {<<: *base}
78	    expect: {eligible: true, monthly_inr: 1000}
79	    source: GR 202501011200000000 p.2 clause 3
80	  - name: age 61 is not eligible
81	    date: 2025-01-15
82	    person: {<<: *base, age: 61}
83	    expect: {eligible: false}
84	    source: GR 202501011200000000 p.2 clause 4(2)
85	```
86	
87	Write cases just below, at and just above every limit, one per condition, and one dated before the scheme starts (`expect: {eligible: false, in_force: false}`).
88	
89	## 5. Check
90	
91	```bash
92	python -m niyam_rulebook test    # must print 0 failed and no PROBLEM lines
93	```
94

1	# Interpretation glossary: Maharashtra government resolutions
2	
3	How Niyam reads recurring legal phrases. Generic entries only.
4	
5	## "पेक्षा जास्त नसावे" (should not be more than)
6	Inclusive upper limit: a value equal to the limit is allowed.
7	
8	## "पेक्षा जास्त" (more than)
9	Strict comparison: a value equal to the limit is not "more than" the limit.
10	
11	## "किंवा त्यापेक्षा जास्त" (or more than that)
12	Inclusive: a value equal to the limit counts.
13	
14	## "वयाची N वर्षे पूर्ण होईपर्यंत" (until N years of age are completed)
15	Store ages as completed years and treat age N as inside the range, unless the order says otherwise. Flag for human confirmation.
16	
17	## Dates
18	A GR applies from its own date unless it states another start date.

1	"""Niyam rulebook engine.
2	
3	Rules live in YAML so that people and agents can read and review them:
4	
5	- ``schema/person.yaml``       the facts about a person that rules may use
6	- ``parameters/<state>/<scheme>/<name>.yaml``  dated values (OpenFisca format)
7	- ``schemes/<state>/<scheme>.yaml``  conditions and benefit, each with a source
8	- ``tests/<state>/<scheme>.yaml``    test citizens with expected results
9	
10	Every parameter value and every condition is dated, so the rulebook can answer
11	"what were the rules on a given day?" and history is never overwritten.
12	"""
13	
14	from __future__ import annotations
15	
16	import datetime as dt
17	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
18	from pathlib import Path
19	from typing import Any
20	
21	import yaml
22	
23	from .safe_eval import RuleExpressionError, evaluate, names_used
24	
25	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
26	
27	
28	def _to_date(value: Any) -> dt.date:
29	    if isinstance(value, dt.datetime):
30	        return value.date()
31	    if isinstance(value, dt.date):
32	        return value
33	    return dt.date.fromisoformat(str(value))
34	
35	
36	@dataclass
37	class ParamValue:
38	    start: dt.date
39	    value: Any
40	    reference: dict[str, Any]
41	
42	
43	@dataclass
44	class Parameter:
45	    key: str
46	    description: str
47	    unit: str | None
48	    values: list[ParamValue]
49	
50	    def at(self, on: dt.date) -> ParamValue | None:
51	        current = None
52	        for v in self.values:
53	            if v.start <= on:
54	                current = v
55	        return current
56	
57	
58	@dataclass
59	class Condition:
60	    id: str
61	    text: str
62	    when: str
63	    source: dict[str, Any]
64	    valid_from: dt.date
65	    valid_until: dt.date | None = None
66	    kind: str = "eligibility"
67	
68	    def active(self, on: dt.date) -> bool:
69	        return self.valid_from <= on and (self.valid_until is None or on <= self.valid_until)
70	
71	
72	@dataclass
73	class Scheme:
74	    id: str
75	    data: dict[str, Any]
76	    conditions: list[Condition]
77	    params: dict[str, Parameter] = field(default_factory=dict)
78	
79	    @property
80	    def name(self) -> str:
81	        return self.data["name"]
82	
83	    def params_at(self, on: dt.date) -> dict[str, Any]:
84	        out = {}
85	        for name, p in self.params.items():
86	            v = p.at(on)
87	            if v is not None:
88	                out[name] = v.value
89	        return out
90	
91	
92	class Rulebook:
93	    def __init__(self, root: Path | str = ROOT):
94	        self.root = Path(root)
95	        self.person_schema: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
96	        self.schemes: dict[str, Scheme] = {}
97	        self.sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
98	        self._load()
99	
100	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ load
101	    def _load(self) -> None:
102	        schema = yaml.safe_load((self.root / "schema" / "person.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
103	        self.person_schema = schema["fields"]
104	        src_file = self.root / "sources" / "index.yaml"
105	        if src_file.exists():
106	            self.sources = yaml.safe_load(src_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or {}
107	        for path in sorted((self.root / "schemes").rglob("*.yaml")):
108	            data = yaml.safe_load(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
109	            conditions = [
110	                Condition(
111	                    id=c["id"],
112	                    text=c["text"],
113	                    when=c["when"],
114	                    source=c.get("source", {}),
115	                    valid_from=_to_date(c["valid_from"]),
116	                    valid_until=_to_date(c["valid_until"]) if c.get("valid_until") else None,
117	                    kind=c.get("kind", "eligibility"),
118	                )
119	                for c in data.get("conditions", [])
120	            ]
121	            scheme = Scheme(id=data["id"], data=data, conditions=conditions)
122	            param_dir = self.root / "parameters" / Path(*data["id"].split("."))
123	            for ppath in sorted(param_dir.glob("*.yaml")):
124	                pdata = yaml.safe_load(ppath.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
125	                values = []
126	                for start, entry in (pdata.get("values") or {}).items():
127	                    entry = entry if isinstance(entry, dict) else {"value": entry}
128	                    values.append(
129	                        ParamValue(
130	                            start=_to_date(start),
131	                            value=entry.get("value"),
132	                            reference=(entry.get("metadata") or {}).get("reference", {}),
133	                        )
134	                    )
135	                values.sort(key=lambda v: v.start)
136	                meta = pdata.get("metadata") or {}
137	                scheme.params[ppath.stem] = Parameter(
138	                    key=f"{data['id']}.{ppath.stem}",
139	                    description=pdata.get("description", ""),
140	                    unit=meta.get("unit"),
141	                    values=values,
142	                )
143	            self.schemes[scheme.id] = scheme
144	
145	    # -------------------------------------------------------------- persons
146	    def normalise_person(self, person: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
147	        out = {}
148	        for name, spec in self.person_schema.items():
149	            value = person.get(name, spec.get("default"))
150	            if value is None:
151	                out[name] = None
152	                continue
153	            kind = spec.get("type")
154	            if kind == "int":
155	                value = int(value)
156	            elif kind == "number":
157	                value = float(value)
158	            elif kind == "bool":
159	                value = value if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value).lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}
160	            elif kind == "enum" and value not in spec.get("values", []):
161	                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be one of {spec.get('values')}, got {value!r}")
162	            out[name] = value
163	        unknown = set(person) - set(self.person_schema)
164	        if unknown:
165	            raise ValueError(f"unknown person fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
166	        return out
167	
168	    # ------------------------------------------------------------- evaluate
169	    def evaluate(self, person: dict[str, Any], on: dt.date | str | None = None,
170	                 schemes: list[str] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
171	        on = _to_date(on) if on else dt.date.today()
172	        p = self.normalise_person(person)
173	        results = {}
174	        for sid, scheme in self.schemes.items():
175	            if schemes and sid not in schemes:
176	                continue
177	            launched = _to_date(scheme.data["launched"])
178	            closed = scheme.data.get("closed")
179	            if on < launched or (closed and on > _to_date(closed)):
180	                results[sid] = {"eligible": False, "in_force": False, "monthly_inr": 0, "reasons": []}
181	                continue
182	            params = scheme.params_at(on)
183	            reasons = []
184	            for c in scheme.conditions:
185	                if not c.active(on):
186	                    continue
187	                met = bool(evaluate(c.when, p, params))
188	                reasons.append({
189	                    "id": c.id,
190	                    "text": self.render_text(c.text, params),
191	                    "met": met,
192	                    "source": c.source,
193	                })
194	            eligible = all(r["met"] for r in reasons)
195	            monthly = 0
196	            benefit = scheme.data.get("benefit", {}).get("monthly_inr")
197	            if eligible and benefit:
198	                monthly = evaluate(benefit, p, params)
199	                if isinstance(monthly, float) and monthly.is_integer():
200	                    monthly = int(monthly)
201	            results[sid] = {"eligible": eligible, "in_force": True, "monthly_inr": monthly, "reasons": reasons}
202	        return results
203	
204	    @staticmethod
205	    def render_text(text: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
206	        def fmt(v: Any) -> str:
207	            if isinstance(v, list):
208	                return ", ".join(str(x) for x in v)
209	            if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool) and v >= 1000:
210	                return f"{v:,.0f}"
211	            return str(v)
212	        try:
213	            return text.format(**{k: fmt(v) for k, v in params.items()})
214	        except (KeyError, IndexError):
215	            return text
216	
217	    # ----------------------------------------------------------- inspection
218	    def rules_at(self, scheme_id: str, on: dt.date | str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
219	        on = _to_date(on) if on else dt.date.today()
220	        s = self.schemes[scheme_id]
221	        params = s.params_at(on)
222	        return {
223	            "id": s.id,
224	            "name": s.name,
225	            "as_of": on.isoformat(),
226	            "conditions": [
227	                {"id": c.id, "text": self.render_text(c.text, params), "when": c.when,
228	                 "source": c.source, "valid_from": c.valid_from.isoformat(),
229	                 "valid_until": c.valid_until.isoformat() if c.valid_until else None}
230	                for c in s.conditions if c.active(on)
231	            ],
232	            "parameters": {
233	                name: {"value": v.value, "since": v.start.isoformat(), "reference": v.reference,
234	                       "description": s.params[name].description, "unit": s.params[name].unit}
235	                for name in s.params if (v := s.params[name].at(on))
236	            },
237	        }
238	
239	    def check(self) -> list[str]:
240	        """Structural validation. Returns a list of problems (empty means valid)."""
241	        problems = []
242	        for sid, s in self.schemes.items():
243	            for key in ("name", "launched", "department", "summary"):
244	                if key not in s.data:
245	                    problems.append(f"{sid}: missing '{key}'")
246	            ids = [c.id for c in s.conditions]
247	            for c in s.conditions:
248	                where = f"{sid}.{c.id}"
249	                for need in ("doc", "page", "quote"):
250	                    if not c.source.get(need):
251	                        problems.append(f"{where}: source is missing '{need}'")
252	                if c.source.get("doc") and c.source["doc"] not in self.sources:
253	                    problems.append(f"{where}: source doc '{c.source['doc']}' is not in sources/index.yaml")
254	                if c.valid_until and c.valid_until < c.valid_from:
255	                    problems.append(f"{where}: valid_until is before valid_from")
256	                try:
257	                    for root, attr in names_used(c.when):
258	                        if root == "person" and attr not in self.person_schema:
259	                            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown person field '{attr}'")
260	                        if root == "params" and attr not in s.params:
261	                            problems.append(f"{where}: unknown parameter '{attr}'")
262	                except RuleExpressionError as e:
263	                    problems.append(f"{where}: {e}")
264	            for cid in set(ids):
265	                periods = sorted((c.valid_from, c.valid_until or dt.date.max) for c in s.conditions if c.id == cid)
266	                for (a0, a1), (b0, _) in zip(periods, periods[1:]):
267	                    if b0 <= a1:
268	                        problems.append(f"{sid}.{cid}: overlapping validity periods")
269	            for name, p in s.params.items():
270	                if not p.values:
271	                    problems.append(f"{sid}: parameter '{name}' has no values")
272	                for v in p.values:
273	                    ref = v.reference or {}
274	                    if not ref.get("doc"):
275	                        problems.append(f"{sid}: parameter '{name}' value from {v.start} has no reference doc")
276	        return problems
277

1	# Instructions for coding agents working in this rulebook
2	
3	This repository is the Niyam rulebook: Maharashtra welfare scheme eligibility
4	rules as tested code. Every rule must trace back to an official government
5	document. Wrong rules can stop people from receiving money they are owed.
6	
7	## Layout
8	- `schemes/<state>/<scheme>.yaml`: conditions and benefit. Every condition has `valid_from`, optional `valid_until`, and a `source` (doc, page, clause, quote, quote_en).
9	- `parameters/<state>/<scheme>/<name>.yaml`: dated values in OpenFisca format. Each value has `metadata.reference` (doc, page, clause, quote, quote_en).
10	- `tests/<state>/<scheme>.yaml`: test citizens. Each case has `date`, `person`, `expect` and `source`.
11	- `sources/index.yaml` and `sources/<state>/<code>.pdf`: the official documents.

## 2024-06-28: Mukhyamantri - Majhi Ladki Bahin scheme created (GR 202406281814018230)

Source: [GR 202406281814018230](https://gr.maharashtra.gov.in/Site/Upload/Government%20Resolutions/Marathi/202406281814018230.pdf)

**English.** The scheme starts on 28 June 2024. Women aged 21 to 60 who live in Maharashtra, are married, widowed, divorced, abandoned or destitute, and have a bank account are eligible. The family must have income up to Rs 2.50 lakh a year, no income tax payer, no regular or contract government employee or pensioner, no current or former MP or MLA, no board or corporation post holder, farm land up to 5 acres, and no four-wheeler registered to a family member. Outsourced and volunteer workers do not disqualify. The benefit is Rs 1,500 a month, reduced by any amount the woman already gets from other government schemes. A woman who gets more than Rs 1,500 from other schemes is not eligible. Open questions for human confirmation: age 60 is treated as eligible (glossary reading), and a woman who gets exactly Rs 1,500 from other schemes is eligible but receives Rs 0 under the top-up reading.

**हिंदी.** यह योजना 28 जून 2024 से शुरू होती है। महाराष्ट्र में रहने वाली, 21 से 60 वर्ष की आयु की विवाहित, विधवा, तलाकशुदा, परित्यक्ता या निराधार महिलाएं, जिनका बैंक खाता है, पात्र हैं। परिवार की वार्षिक आय 2.50 लाख रुपये तक होनी चाहिए। परिवार में कोई आयकरदाता, नियमित या अनुबंध सरकारी कर्मचारी, पेंशनधारी, मौजूदा या पूर्व सांसद/विधायक, बोर्ड या निगम का पदाधिकारी नहीं होना चाहिए। परिवार के नाम पर 5 एकड़ से अधिक कृषि भूमि और चारपहिया वाहन (ट्रैक्टर को छोड़कर) नहीं होना चाहिए। बाह्य यंत्रणा के कर्मचारी और स्वयंसेवी कार्यकर्ता अपात्र नहीं होंगे। लाभ 1,500 रुपये प्रति माह है, जिसमें से अन्य सरकारी योजनाओं से मिलने वाली राशि घटाई जाएगी। अन्य योजनाओं से 1,500 रुपये से अधिक लाभ पाने वाली महिला पात्र नहीं है। मानव सत्यापन के लिए खुले प्रश्न: 60 वर्ष की आयु पात्र मानी गई है (शब्दकोश के अनुसार), और अन्य योजनाओं से ठीक 1,500 रुपये पाने वाली महिला पात्र है पर उसे 0 रुपये मिलेंगे।

**मराठी.** ही योजना 28 जून 2024 पासून सुरू होते. महाराष्ट्रात राहणाऱ्या, 21 ते 60 वर्षे वयोगटातील विवाहित, विधवा, घटस्फोटित, परित्यक्ता किंवा निराधार महिला, ज्यांचे बँक खाते आहे, त्या पात्र आहेत. कुटुंबाचे वार्षिक उत्पन्न 2.50 लाख रुपयांपर्यंत असावे. कुटुंबात आयकरदाता, नियमित किंवा कंत्राटी शासकीय कर्मचारी, निवृत्तीवेतनधारक, विद्यमान किंवा माजी खासदार/आमदार, मंडळ किंवा महामंडळाचे पदाधिकारी नसावेत. कुटुंबाच्या नावे 5 एकरपेक्षा जास्त शेतजमीन आणि चारचाकी वाहन (ट्रॅक्टर वगळून) नसावे. बाह्य यंत्रणेमार्फत कार्यरत कर्मचारी आणि स्वयंसेवी कामगार अपात्र ठरणार नाहीत. लाभ दरमहा 1,500 रुपये आहे, त्यातून इतर शासकीय योजनांतून मिळणारी रक्कम वजा होईल. इतर योजनांतून 1,500 रुपयांपेक्षा जास्त लाभ घेणारी महिला पात्र नाही. मानवी पडताळणीसाठी खुले प्रश्न: वय 60 पूर्ण असलेली महिला पात्र मानली आहे (शब्दकोशानुसार), आणि इतर योजनांतून नेमके 1,500 रुपये घेणारी महिला पात्र आहे पण तिला 0 रुपये मिळतील.
